54:  * This class facilitates interaction with Coordinator/Overlord leader nodes. Instance of this class is injected

56:  * Usage:
57:  * Request request = druidLeaderClient.makeRequest(HttpMethod, requestPath)
58:  * request.setXXX(..)
59:  * FullResponseHolder responseHolder = druidLeaderClient.go(request)
60:  */
61: public class DruidLeaderClient
62: {
63:   private final Logger log = new Logger(DruidLeaderClient.class);
64: 
65:   private static final int MAX_RETRIES = 5;
66: 
67:   private final HttpClient httpClient;
68:   private final DruidNodeDiscoveryProvider druidNodeDiscoveryProvider;
69:   private final NodeRole nodeRoleToWatch;
70: 
71:   private final String leaderRequestPath;
72: 
73:   private LifecycleLock lifecycleLock = new LifecycleLock();
74:   private DruidNodeDiscovery druidNodeDiscovery;
75:   private AtomicReference<String> currentKnownLeader = new AtomicReference<>();
76: 
77:   public DruidLeaderClient(
78:       HttpClient httpClient,
79:       DruidNodeDiscoveryProvider druidNodeDiscoveryProvider,
80:       NodeRole nodeRoleToWatch,
81:       String leaderRequestPath
82:   )
83:   {
84:     this.httpClient = httpClient;
85:     this.druidNodeDiscoveryProvider = druidNodeDiscoveryProvider;
86:     this.nodeRoleToWatch = nodeRoleToWatch;
87:     this.leaderRequestPath = leaderRequestPath;
88:   }
89: 
90:   @LifecycleStart
91:   public void start()
92:   {
93:     if (!lifecycleLock.canStart()) {
94:       throw new ISE("can't start.");
95:     }
96: 
97:     try {
98:       druidNodeDiscovery = druidNodeDiscoveryProvider.getForNodeRole(nodeRoleToWatch);
99:       lifecycleLock.started();
100:       log.debug("Started.");
101:     }
102:     finally {
103:       lifecycleLock.exitStart();
104:     }
105:   }
106: 
107:   @LifecycleStop
108:   public void stop()
109:   {
110:     if (!lifecycleLock.canStop()) {
111:       throw new ISE("can't stop.");
112:     }
113: 
114:     log.debug("Stopped.");
115:   }
116: 
117:   /**
118:    * Make a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
119:    */
120:   public Request makeRequest(HttpMethod httpMethod, String urlPath) throws IOException
121:   {
122:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
123:     return new Request(httpMethod, new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s", getCurrentKnownLeader(true), urlPath)));
124:   }
125: 
126:   public StringFullResponseHolder go(Request request) throws IOException, InterruptedException
127:   {
128:     return go(request, new StringFullResponseHandler(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
129:   }
130: 
131:   /**
132:    * Executes a Request object aimed at the leader. Throws IOException if the leader cannot be located.
133:    */
134:   public <T, H extends FullResponseHolder<T>> H go(Request request, HttpResponseHandler<H, H> responseHandler)
135:       throws IOException, InterruptedException
136:   {
137:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
138:     for (int counter = 0; counter < MAX_RETRIES; counter++) {
139: 
140:       final H fullResponseHolder;
141: 
142:       try {
143:         try {
144:           fullResponseHolder = httpClient.go(request, responseHandler).get();
145:         }
146:         catch (ExecutionException e) {
147:           // Unwrap IOExceptions and ChannelExceptions, re-throw others
148:           Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf(e.getCause(), IOException.class);
149:           Throwables.propagateIfInstanceOf(e.getCause(), ChannelException.class);
150:           throw new RE(e, "HTTP request to[%s] failed", request.getUrl());
151:         }
152:       }
153:       catch (IOException | ChannelException ex) {
154:         // can happen if the node is stopped.
155:         log.warn(ex, "Request[%s] failed.", request.getUrl());
156:         request = copy(request, null);
157:         continue;
158:       }
159: 
160:       if (HttpResponseStatus.TEMPORARY_REDIRECT.equals(fullResponseHolder.getResponse().getStatus())) {
161:         request = copy(request, fullResponseHolder);
162:       } else {
163:         return fullResponseHolder;
164:       }
165:     }
166: 
167:     throw new IOE("Retries exhausted, couldn't fulfill request to [%s].", request.getUrl());
168:   }

170:   public String findCurrentLeader()
171:   {
172:     Preconditions.checkState(lifecycleLock.awaitStarted(1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS));
173:     final StringFullResponseHolder responseHolder;
174:     try {
175:       responseHolder = go(makeRequest(HttpMethod.GET, leaderRequestPath));
176:     }
177:     catch (Exception ex) {
178:       throw new ISE(ex, "Couldn't find leader.");
179:     }
180: 
181:     if (responseHolder.getStatus().getCode() == 200) {
182:       String leaderUrl = responseHolder.getContent();
183: 
184:       //verify this is valid url
185:       try {
186:         URL validatedUrl = new URL(leaderUrl);
187:         currentKnownLeader.set(leaderUrl);
188: 
189:         // validatedUrl.toString() is returned instead of leaderUrl or else teamcity build fails because of breaking
190:         // the rule of ignoring new URL(leaderUrl) object.
191:         return validatedUrl.toString();
192:       }
193:       catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
194:         log.error(ex, "Received malformed leader url[%s].", leaderUrl);
195:       }
196:     }
197: 
198:     throw new ISE(
199:         "Couldn't find leader, failed response status is [%s] and content [%s].",
200:         responseHolder.getStatus().getCode(),
201:         responseHolder.getContent()
202:     );
203:   }

205:   private String getCurrentKnownLeader(final boolean cached) throws IOException
206:   {
207:     final String leader = currentKnownLeader.accumulateAndGet(
208:         null,
209:         (current, given) -> current == null || !cached ? pickOneHost() : current
210:     );
211: 
212:     if (leader == null) {
213:       throw new IOE("No known server");
214:     } else {
215:       return leader;
216:     }
217:   }

219:   @Nullable
220:   private String pickOneHost()
221:   {
222:     DiscoveryDruidNode node = pickOneNode();
223:     if (node != null) {

225:           "%s://%s",
226:           node.getDruidNode().getServiceScheme(),
227:           node.getDruidNode().getHostAndPortToUse()
228:       );
229:     }
230: 
231:     return null;
232:   }
233: 
234:   @Nullable
235:   private DiscoveryDruidNode pickOneNode()
236:   {
237:     Iterator<DiscoveryDruidNode> iter = druidNodeDiscovery.getAllNodes().iterator();
238:     if (iter.hasNext()) {
239:       return iter.next();
240:     }
241:     return null;
242:   }

244:   private void rememberRedirectedLeader(URL redirectUrl)
245:   {
246:     currentKnownLeader.set(StringUtils.format(
247:         "%s://%s:%s",
248:         redirectUrl.getProtocol(),
249:         redirectUrl.getHost(),
250:         redirectUrl.getPort()
251:     ));
252:   }

254:   private void logRedirect(URL requestUrl, String redirectUrlStr)
255:   {
256:     log.info("Request[%s] received redirect response to location [%s].", requestUrl, redirectUrlStr);
257:   }

259:   private Request copy(Request oldRequest, @Nullable FullResponseHolder<?> fullResponseHolder) throws IOException
260:   {
261:     final URL oldUrl = oldRequest.getUrl();
262:     final String path = oldUrl.getPath();
263:     final String query = oldUrl.getQuery();
264:     final URL targetUrl;
265: 
266:     if (fullResponseHolder != null) {
267:       final HttpResponse response = fullResponseHolder.getResponse();
268:       final HttpResponseStatus status = response.getStatus();
269:       if (!HttpResponseStatus.TEMPORARY_REDIRECT.equals(status)) {
270:         throw new IOE("No redirect location is found in response from url[%s].", oldUrl);
271:       }
272: 
273:       final String redirectUrlStr = response.headers().get("Location");
274:       if (redirectUrlStr == null) {
275:         throw new IOE("No redirect location is found in response from url[%s].", oldUrl);
276:       }
277: 
278:       logRedirect(oldUrl, redirectUrlStr);
279: 
280:       try {
281:         targetUrl = new URL(redirectUrlStr);
282:       }
283:       catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
284:         throw new IOE(
285:             ex,
286:             "Malformed redirect location is found in response from url[%s], new location[%s].",
287:             oldUrl,
288:             redirectUrlStr
289:         );
290:       }
291: 
292:       rememberRedirectedLeader(targetUrl);
293:     } else {
294:       final DiscoveryDruidNode node = pickOneNode();
295:       if (node == null) {
296:         currentKnownLeader.set(null);
297:         throw new IOE("No known server");
298:       }
299: 
300:       final String leader = StringUtils.format(
301:           "%s://%s",
302:           node.getDruidNode().getServiceScheme(),
303:           node.getDruidNode().getHostAndPortToUse()
304:       );
305:       currentKnownLeader.set(leader);
306: 
307:       try {
308:         if (query == null) {
309:           targetUrl = new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s", leader, path));
310:         } else {
311:           targetUrl = new URL(StringUtils.format("%s%s?%s", leader, path, query));
312:         }
313:       }
314:       catch (MalformedURLException e) {
315:         // Not an IOException; this is our own fault.
316:         throw new ISE(
317:             e,
318:             "failed to build url with path[%] and query string [%s].",
319:             path,
320:             query
321:         );
322:       }
323:     }
324: 
325:     final Request req = new Request(oldRequest.getMethod(), targetUrl);
326:     req.addHeaderValues(oldRequest.getHeaders());
327:     if (oldRequest.hasContent()) {
328:       req.setContent(oldRequest.getContent());
329:     }
330:     return req;
331:   }
